review_notes: GOD RULE meta-harness: verifies all Kani harnesses use kani::any() not hardcoded dummy data. Code inspection by proof-reviewer required.

Digest equality is behavioral equality property, not a refinement/type-state predicate. Flux RS is designed for constructor-enforced invariants. Kani (bounded exhaustive) + Proptest (property-based) provide stronger coverage for this obligation. Decision is justified with concrete evidence.

Loom tests concurrent Rust with schedule exploration. digest_step_primitive is single-threaded pure sequential function — no atomics, channels, locks, async, or concurrent interleavings. No concurrency in scope. Decision is justified.

Miri detects undefined behavior in unsafe Rust. digest_step_primitive uses only safe blake3::Hasher, String, Vec, Option<u32> — no raw pointers, MaybeUninit, or FFI. No unsafe code in scope. Decision is justified.

Fuzzing targets adversarial input at trust boundaries. canonical_digest takes validated WorkflowSource (well-typed AST), not raw bytes. No parser, protocol frame, or untrusted input boundary. Digest is a deterministic pure function. Decision is justified.
